notes: τὸν πατέρα is read under rule 92: the article takes the supplied *a* and the noun carries *that is … father*.
The first *and* (t016) is added under rules 86 and 98, joining two asyndetic finite clauses with no source token to license it; the second answers to the expressed καί at s018.
ὁ υἱός takes *his* on the article under rule 20's second arm, no genitive pronoun standing in the clause.
